strict_frozen_rule_reason: Every effort produced at least one blind-adjudicated critical mapping error, so no effort passed the zero-critical-error interpretation of the gate.
operational_decision: Use high: high and xhigh tie on adjudicated semantic acceptability and critical-error count; high is more repeatable, faster, and lower-token than xhigh. Medium's paired lower confidence bound against high crosses the frozen five-point non-inferiority margin.
claim_boundary: Operational choice on a 24-descriptor challenge-enriched Phase-1 cohort and nine fixed-input Phase-2 transitions. Reviews are research-agent judgments rather than human or expert gold labels; Phase 2 is not an end-to-end effort-specific chain.
